DATA EXPLORATION

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data("starwars")
str(starwars)

```

```{r}
head(starwars)

```

```{r}
attach(starwars)
names(starwars)

```

To find the number of variables

```{r}
length(starwars)
```

To list the observations in the hair color variable

```{r}
unique(hair_color)
```

To list the number of observations per each hair color

```{r}
table(hair_color)
```

Sorting from the largest to the smallest

```{r}
sort(table(hair_color),decreasing = TRUE)
```

Plotting a bar graph from the data

```{r}
barplot(sort(table(hair_color),decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r}
starwars %>% 
  select(hair_color) %>% 
  count(hair_color) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  gt() %>%
  gt_theme_guardian() %>% 
  tab_header(title= "Starwars Characters")

```

To display missing observations

```{r}
starwars %>% 
  filter(!complete.cases(hair_color)) %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  gt_theme_pff()
```

To generate statistical analysis of the height variable

```{r}
summary(height)
```

To display the shape of our data

```{r}
boxplot(height)
```

To plot a histogram for the height variable

```{r}
hist(height)
```

SEPARATE AND UNITE

```{r}
library(gapminder)

```

We will be working with the Gapminder dataset

```{r}
print(gapminder)
```

To separate the year into Century and Year

```{r}
gapmiber1 <- gapminder %>% 
  select(country,year,pop) %>% 
  separate(col = year,into = c("Century","Year"),sep=2) %>% 
  print()
```

To separate the starwars characters names into First name and Last name

```{r}
starwars %>% 
  separate(name , into = c("First_Name","Last Name"),sep = " ") %>% 
  print()
```

UNITING THE DATA

```{r}
gapmiber1 %>% 
  unite(col = year,Century,Year,sep="") %>% 
  print()
```
